candidates.name: Russia-Kazakhstan Gas Pipeline (Tyumen region to Ishim-Astana border section)
candidates.from: Tyumen region (West Siberian gas transmission system, near Ishim)

evidence.note: Gazprom-Kazakhstan MoU for new main gas pipeline Russia to Kazakhstan, 10 bcm/y initial capacity, passing through municipalities of Tyumen region bordering North Kazakhstan.

candidates.why_maybe_new: Roster P8087 Ishim-Astana (658 km) appears to cover the Kazakh side; the Russian-side Tyumen section is not separately listed. Length of Russian section unknown (may be under 25 km or may be folded into P8087); consolidator to decide.
